newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria June industrial sales fall 12 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria June industrial sales fall 12 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgaria's receipts from industrial sales fell a real 12 percent year on year in June to 1.31 trillion levs at current prices, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said on Thursday.
Receipts from sales of both the state and private sectors totalled 6.373 trillion levs for the first six months of this year, down a real 15 percent from the same period of 1996.

Sales of the state industrial sector alone totalled 987 billion levs in June, a real 20 percent down from June 1996 but sales of the private sector rose a real 20 percent to around 325 billion levs at current prices.

State industrial sales for the first six months stood at 5.077 trillion levs, down a real 18.8 percent from the same period of last year as sales of the private sector rose a real three percent to 1,296 billion levs at current prices, the NSI said.
The rise in industrial sales of the private sector was attributed mainly to the increasing number of private firms in the course of Bulgaria's sell-off programme over the past year, the NSI said.
The private sector share in total industrial sales has risen to around 25 percent in June from 10-14 percent at the beginning of the year, NSI figures showed.

State industrial sector domestic sales fell a real 28 percent year on year in June and were down 30 percent year on year in the first six months due to lower number of orders resulting from Bulgaria's economic crisis and soaring year on year inflation.
State sector exports fell a real seven percent year on year in June and were up a real one percent from January through June compared to the same period of 1996.
Figures for domestic sales and exports of the private sector were not available.

Monthly consumer price inflation for June was 0.8 percent and inflation for the first six months was 484.2 percent. Year on year inflation for June was 1,526.7 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
